info.title: Knowledge graph L2-BPMN: BPMN Task API
info.description: A task or sub-process. It is what a DMN usingTask href points at, what sequence flows connect, and what a DAK-level task entry describes. Sub-processes carry isSubProcess rather than getting a class of their own -- the lifecycle BPMN has exactly one. Class IRI: http://smart.who.int/kg/bpmn-task.

resourceType.description: Resource type identifier for KGBpmnTask logical model

id.description: The identifier the source declares (an FSH instance id, a BPMN or DMN element id).
